comment: Two parameters and two inputs belonging to the algorithm morph are declared but never given a widget on this panel: the morph amount and its target algorithm, with a CV jack each (bell.cpp:183). They are reached from the menu and from the OP MORPH expander instead, so no click on the panel can get at them. The engine is Google's music-synthesizer-for-android DX7 core, reading the packed cartridge format exactly as the hardware stores it.
